hero.undertitel: How your information is handled on this website

body:
The contact form

When you send a message via the contact form, your name, email address and message are processed for one purpose only: to read and reply to it. The message is delivered via Formspree to BibelBecca's email. Your information is never shared with anyone else and is not used for marketing. If you want your message deleted, just get in touch.

No cookies or tracking

This website uses no cookies and no tracking. The only settings stored in your browser (locally – they never leave your device) are your choice of light/dark mode and language.

YouTube videos

Videos on this site only load when you press play. They are played through YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com), which doesn't set cookies until you start playback. Once you play a video, Google's privacy policy applies.

Questions?

Reach out via the contact page or email directly – the contact details are in the footer.
